subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned 20-PR-limit notice remain open as active contributor policy, or should it be closed now that the docs and automation are shipped?
rationale: The code/docs/test behavior is already implemented, but a maintainer explicitly renamed, pinned, and reopened the issue after the first implementation, so automation should not override that visibility choice.

options.title: Keep the pinned notice open
options.body: Use this issue as the current contributor-facing policy announcement while relying on `CONTRIBUTING.md` and Barnacle for enforceable details.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: Close the issue with evidence that `CONTRIBUTING.md`, Labeler, Barnacle, and `v2026.6.11` all contain the 20-cap behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the current contributor-facing policy announcement while relying on `CONTRIBUTING.md` and Barnacle for enforceable details.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the current 20-cap rename and later pinned/reopened the issue, making them the clearest owner for the issue-state decision.
